items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: INTERVIEWER: There was one old man, Valto. INTERVIEWEE: That's it. Not Valto.

ctx.x: There was one old man, Valto.
Or Palau? Jimmy Palau? No. It may come to you later, so don't worry about it. Your father played guitar, any other instruments then?
